messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise overview of the **federal public holidays** in Canada for 2023 that generate *long weekends* (i.e., a holiday falling on a weekday adjacent to a weekend or an observed holiday creating a weekend).  
For holidays that vary by province, I've noted the provinces where they apply.

| Holiday | Date 2023 | Observed (if applicable) | Long Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-----------|--------------------------|---------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | Monday, Jan 2 | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend from Dec 31 (Sat) to Jan 2 (Mon). |
| **Family Day** | Monday, Feb 20 | — | **Yes** | Only in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, and Prince Edward Island. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | — | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend from Apr 7 (Fri) to Apr 9 (Sun). |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | — | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend from May 20 (Sat) to May 22 (Mon). |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | Monday, Jul 3 | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend from Jul 1 (Sat) to Jul 3 (Mon). |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | — | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend from Sep 2 (Sat) to Sep 4 (Mon). |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | — | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend from Oct 7 (Sat) to Oct 9 (Mon). |
| **Remembrance Day** | Wednesday, Nov 11 | Friday, Nov 13 (in some provinces) | No | Even when observed on Friday, it does not create a long weekend. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | — | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend from Dec 23 (Sat) to Dec 25 (Mon). |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday, Dec 26 | — | No | Combined with Christmas, it extends the holiday period but does not add a weekend day. |

### Summary of Long Weekends (Federal Holidays)

| Long Weekend | Dates (2023) | Holiday |
|--------------|--------------|---------|
| Dec 31 – Jan 2 | New Year’s Day |
| Feb 18 – Feb 20 | Family Day (provinces listed above) |
| Apr 7 – Apr 9 | Good Friday |
| May 20 – May 22 | Victoria Day |
| Jul 1 – Jul 3 | Canada Day |
| Sep 2 – Sep 4 | Labour Day |
| Oct 7 – Oct 9 | Thanksgiving |
| Dec 23 – Dec 25 | Christmas Day |

> **Note:** Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.). If your app needs province‑specific data, let me know which provinces you're targeting, and I can provide those details as well.
